bigger.definitionCn: adj. 更大（big 的比较级）
englishDefinitions: larger in size, amount, or degree; comparative of big

heavier.definitionCn: adj. 更重的；较重的（heavy 的比较级）
englishDefinitions: having more weight; comparative of heavy
greater in length or duration; comparative of long
less in length, height, or duration; comparative of short
less in size or amount; comparative of small
having more strength or power; comparative of strong
greater in height; comparative of tall
having a lower age; comparative of young

gulled.definitionCn: vt. 欺骗；愚弄（gull 的过去式和过去分词）
englishDefinitions: past tense and past participle of gull: deceived or tricked someone

resumed.definitionCn: v. 重新开始；继续；恢复（resume 的过去式和过去分词）
englishDefinitions: past tense and past participle of resume: started or continued again after a pause; returned to a former place or position

underestimated.definitionCn: vt. 低估；看轻（underestimate 的过去式和过去分词）
englishDefinitions: past tense and past participle of underestimate: judged a quantity or ability to be lower than it really was

patronymics.definitionCn: n. 源于父名的姓或名字（patronymic 的复数）
englishDefinitions: plural of patronymic: names derived from a father's or paternal ancestor's name
